description: Elisabeth’s unexpected engagement to Franz brings her into the Habsburg court, where her instinctive independence collides with Archduchess Sophie’s expectations and a restless empire presses political danger against the new marriage.

s01e01.description: Helene and Elisabeth travel to meet Emperor Franz, who is expected to choose Helene, but his unexpected decision changes both sisters’ futures.

s01e02.description: Elisabeth arrives in Vienna for the wedding and immediately collides with palace expectations while Franz tries to keep Austria out of war.

s01e03.description: Elisabeth and Franz marry as her growing popularity unsettles the court and old secrets threaten the carefully managed imperial image.

s01e04.description: Pressure for military action intensifies while Elisabeth’s encounter with the Russian court creates political consequences Franz cannot easily contain.

s01e05.description: Elisabeth’s attempt to help ordinary people backfires at court, while Maximilian builds support for his own ambitions and Leontine draws closer to the empress.

s01e06.description: Elisabeth turns toward Maximilian as her marriage strains, while Franz seeks reconciliation and revolutionary unrest closes in on the palace.
